'''Mortex Sector HQ''' was the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Sector Headquarters]] for [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Fangol]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was buried underground, and was powered by [[thermal collector]]s connected to the planet's molten core. Due to Fangol's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], an [[Fangol's artificial moon|artificial moon]] was in geosynchronous [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the base to facilitate communications and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans.

The base was staffed by around three thousand personnel. A third of the personnel were administrators; another third were support staff including laborers, [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]], and communication experts; and the final third were [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. The base's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] complement included five [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]], six [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], and one hundred [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].

[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lawra Mers]] was stationed at the base as [[field mission commander]], coordinating dozens of Alliance strike teams across the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].
